atomic: joins the room (mirrors JoinRoom) AND mints TURN credentials for the freshly-inserted peer in one RPC. Uses a DEDICATED high-capacity room (`join_session_room_id`) — the main `room_id` is filled to its cap by JoinRoom's iters. `ttl_seconds` int32 = TURN credential lifetime; TURN config must be present (fail-closed). Returns new `peer_id` + ICE servers.
